method.dcf_basis: 10-year FCF DCF on the latest annual free cash flow, WACC 11%, terminal growth 2.5%, growth 5% / 10% / 15% for conservative / base / optimistic
method.starting_fcf: latest annual free cash flow from the live pull
method.fetcher: Yahoo Finance via tools/finance.py (retried since Step 54)

limitations: Live data is used in memory only — it is never written to the database and never overwrites stored statements.
Detection bands are margin bands only and provisional: business quality (Step 24) and deterioration (Step 27) are unknown from a live pull, so no band is a confirmed Step 26 candidate.
Banks, insurers and REITs need the Step 22 sector models — an FCF DCF is not valid for them, so they usually come back insufficient_data.
A single-method FCF DCF is a research figure, not a fair-value estimate and never a recommendation; the final decision is always the owner's.
